subject.title: feat(sessions): raise default session-store disk budget to 10 GiB

question: Should existing agents with no explicit `session.maintenance.maxDiskBytes` automatically move from a 2 GiB to a 10 GiB per-agent retention budget on upgrade?
rationale: The code correctly applies the requested fallback, but the fivefold default increase intentionally changes the disk-consumption and retention policy of existing installations; source inspection cannot determine the acceptable default without owner intent.

options.title: Confirm the 10 GiB default
options.body: Accept the higher upgrade-time disk allowance after adding redacted runtime proof of resolved thresholds and cleanup behavior.

options.title: Keep the 2 GiB default
options.body: Preserve existing upgrade behavior and direct users needing longer retention to the already-supported explicit `maxDiskBytes` setting.

recommendation.title: Confirm the 10 GiB default
recommendation.body: Accept the higher upgrade-time disk allowance after adding redacted runtime proof of resolved thresholds and cleanup behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work and this proposal both connect this contributor to the session-maintenance default surface.
